text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) (No. 2) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2025

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu bilion enam ratus

empat puluh juta sembilan puluh enam ribu ringgit (RM1,640,096,000) daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2025 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan

bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 379,910,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 352,369,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 81,984,000

Perbelanjaan lain 143,668,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 682,165,000

JUMLAH 1,640,096,000

Dibuat 12 Disember 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.3(1); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

SIM CHEE KEONG

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) (NO. 2) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72

of the Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

(No. 2) Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2025

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one billion six hundred fourty million ninety six

thousand ringgit (RM1,640,096,000) from the Social Security Fund for the expenditure

on administration of the Social Security Scheme for the year 2025 is hereby authorized

for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 379,910,000

Supplies and services 352,369,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 81,984,000

Other expenditures 143,668,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 682,165,000

TOTAL 1,640,096,000

Made 12 December 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/11/5Jld.3(1); PN(PU2)58/JLD.24]

SIM CHEE KEONG

Minister of Human Resources
